phase60_summary.key_feature: ScanHealthSynthesizer: reads all Phase 56-59 modules every 10 scans, produces health_status (HEALTHY/DEGRADED/CRITICAL), ranked bottleneck list, and single top_action. phase61_summary.key_feature: MomentumScoreRecorder captures raw xgb_momentum per pair per scan. MomentumGapAnalyzer classifies rejects: NEAR_THRESHOLD (gap<=0.05 → lower threshold), MODERATE (0.05-0.15 → XGBoost quality issue), FAR_BELOW (>0.15 → retrain). Logged every 50 scans in engine.py with WARNING on NEAR_THRESHOLD. Closes the gap when SignalFunnelTracker reports dominant_kill_stage=momentum.

phase62_summary.key_feature: AdaptiveMomentumFloor: auto-reduces min_momentum by 0.02/adaptation when MomentumGapAnalyzer classifies NEAR_THRESHOLD. Guards: cooldown=20 scans, max_adaptations=5, floor=0.30. Triggered inside Phase 61 periodic block (every 50 scans). config.min_momentum mutated in-place with INFO log. Completes the observe→adapt loop for momentum gate, mirroring Phase 58 AdaptiveConfidenceFloor.

phase63_summary.key_feature: RiskRejectRecorder captures rf_drawdown_pct (=rf_drawdown_pips/10000) and rf_streak_prob per pair per scan at the risk gate site. RiskGateAnalyzer classifies rejects: NEAR_THRESHOLD (gap<=0.005 → raise threshold 0.002-0.005), MODERATE (0.005-0.015 → RF calibration issue), FAR_ABOVE (>0.015 → verify market/retrain). Gap direction INVERTED: gap = score - threshold (positive = fail). near_miss threshold = 0.005 (20% of 0.025 scale). Completes three-gate diagnostic coverage: confidence (Phase 58), momentum (Phase 61), risk (Phase 63).

wiring.engine_py_periodic: RiskGateAnalyzer.analyze() logged every 50 scans with NEAR_THRESHOLD WARNING branch

phase64_summary.key_feature: AdaptiveDrawdownCeiling: auto-raises max_drawdown_pct by 0.001/adaptation when RiskGateAnalyzer classifies NEAR_THRESHOLD. Direction INVERTED vs Phase 58/62: threshold goes UP not DOWN. tick() wired inside Phase 63 periodic block (every 50 scans) sharing _rga_cls. Completes the full observe→adapt loop for all 3 gates: confidence (Phase 58), momentum (Phase 62), risk (Phase 64).
